entities.name: Q5LWF7
observations: Reviewed Ruegeria pomeroyi dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; EC 3.6.1.66.
Hydrolyzes XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate; binds one Mg2+ per subunit and forms a homodimer.

entities.name: Noncanonical purine NTP hydrolysis
